svg.title: Recovery after a crash
svg.desc: After a restart the ambassador reads the journal for intents that have no outcome. For each one it follows what the capability declares: it asks the external system about the operation id, sends it again, or stops and reports the outcome as unknown for its owner to settle. Then it records the outcome. Find what is unknown: 1. Ambassador calls Journal: unfinished intents. 2. Journal replies to Ambassador: intent, no outcome. Reconcile: If verify: 3a. Ambassador calls External system: did you receive it. 4a. External system replies to Ambassador: yes or no. If resend: 3b. Ambassador calls External system: send same operation id. 4b. External system replies to Ambassador: result. Otherwise: 3c. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: outcome unknown, held for the owner, refused. Close: 5. Ambassador sends to Journal: record outcome.
